components.name: Forever Lights 5-Light RGBW Strand
components.blurb: Five sealed RGBW puck lights on a moulded weatherproof lead. Each puck drops into the track and points down the face of your home.
components.detail: The pucks are the part you actually see at night. Each one carries red, green, blue and warm-white diodes so the same light can run a full-colour holiday scene or a clean warm white on an ordinary evening. The leads snap together with sealed twist connectors, so a run is built strand by strand with no cutting or soldering.

components.name: Aluminum Track, 42 inch with 8 inch spacing
components.blurb: Extruded aluminum channel, 42 inches long, pre-drilled on 8 inch centres to hold five pucks per piece.
components.detail: The channel is what makes the system disappear in daylight. It screws flush to the soffit or fascia, hides the wiring, and acts as a heat sink for the diodes. Available in white, black, brown and beige to match common trim, or a custom colour match on request.

components.name: Forever Lights Power Supply, 150 W
components.blurb: 24 V 150 W constant-voltage waterproof LED driver with a standard plug end.
components.detail: Converts household power down to safe low voltage for the run. It plugs into an existing GFCI-protected outdoor or garage receptacle, which is why a standard install needs no electrical permit. Larger kits include more than one so power can be fed from more than one point.

components.name: Forever Lights WiFi Controller
components.blurb: The brain of the system. Joins your 2.4 GHz WiFi and drives colours, scenes, schedules and zones from the app.
components.detail: One controller runs the whole house. It stores your saved scenes and schedules on board, so a dusk-to-dawn routine keeps running even if your internet drops. You only need the app when you want to change something.

components.name: 1 ft Light Extension Connector
components.blurb: Short sealed jumper for stepping the run across a corner or a narrow break in the soffit.
components.detail: Used wherever the track stops and starts again a short distance away, for example around a corner board or a downspout.

components.name: 5 ft Light Extension Connector
components.blurb: Mid-length jumper for gaps between runs, such as over a garage door or a window bay.
components.detail: Keeps the lit sections evenly spaced while skipping the parts of the elevation you do not want lit.

components.name: 10 ft Light Extension Connector
components.blurb: Longer jumper for crossing a wider unlit span without adding pucks.
components.detail: Common on homes with a recessed entry or a break between the main roofline and a garage wing.

components.name: 20 ft Light Extension Connector
components.blurb: The long jumper, used to reach a separate elevation or carry the run back to the controller.
components.detail: Also the usual way to bring the start of the run from the controller location out to the first piece of track.

components.name: Power T Connector
components.blurb: Splits the low-voltage power feed so one supply can push power into two directions.
components.detail: Power injection keeps the far end of a long run as bright as the near end. The T is how a single supply feeds two branches.

components.name: Light Extension T Connector
components.blurb: Splits the light run itself, so one controller output can branch left and right from a single start point.
components.detail: Handy when the controller sits in the middle of the elevation and the track runs both ways from it.

components.name: 20 ft Power Extension Connector
components.blurb: Extends the run between a power supply and the point where power is injected into the lights.
components.detail: Lets the supply live somewhere sheltered and convenient, such as inside the garage, while still feeding a far corner of the roofline.

components.name: Forever Lights Data Amplifier
components.blurb: Re-boosts the control signal partway along a long run so the last pucks stay in sync.
components.detail: Addressable lighting sends a data signal down the whole chain. Over long distances that signal weakens, which shows up as flicker or wrong colours at the far end. The amplifier cleans it up.

components.name: Box of Colour Matched Screws
components.blurb: 100 pack of coloured-head screws that disappear against the track.
components.detail: Standard on white, black, brown and beige kits. Custom colour orders ship without the screw pack, since the heads are matched to stock colours only.
